title: Value Cards Trading
short_description: Choose, exchange, and defend the values you want a group to carry into a difficult decision.
premise: Participants begin with different value cards, trade to assemble a hand they can stand behind, and then account for what they kept, what they let go, and which values proved difficult to compare.
group_size: Three people per table; any number of tables
alongside: A video or phone call for the full 30 minutes and the debrief
preview_label: A shared table with value cards arranged between private hands and a trading area

title: Democracy Simulation
short_description: Make a collective decision while information, authority, and the costs of delay are unevenly distributed.
premise: A group must act on a shared problem, but no participant begins with the whole picture. The table makes competing proposals and unequal knowledge visible, then asks the group to examine how it reached a decision.
alongside: A video or phone call for the full 60–90 minutes
preview_label: A shared decision table with evidence, proposals, and a decision area
